strings.name: Douglas Diamond
strings.summary: Diamond studies why banks exist, how they supply liquidity and why they face runs. With Philip Dybvig he developed a bank-run model; his delegated-monitoring theory explains financial intermediation. A longtime Chicago professor, he has influenced crisis analysis and bank regulation. He shared the 2022 economics Nobel with Bernanke and Dybvig and continues discussing financial stability.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His theories of bank runs, liquidity and financial intermediation provide important analytical frameworks for bank regulation.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Bank runs and liquidity
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Dybvig, explained the benefits of liquidity transformation and the risk of runs.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Delegated monitoring
strings.highlights.h2.text: Examined how banks pool borrower monitoring and reduce duplicated costs.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discusses financial stability
strings.timeline.t1.text: In a Chicago interview, discussed bank crises and Federal Reserve credibility and independence.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Shares economics Nobel
strings.timeline.t2.text: Honored with Ben Bernanke and Philip Dybvig for research on banks and financial crises.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Receives Onassis finance prize
strings.timeline.t3.text: His financial research received the Onassis Prize.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Publishes delegated-monitoring research
strings.timeline.t4.text: Financial Intermediation and Delegated Monitoring analyzed banks’ role in monitoring borrowers.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Co-publishes bank-run model
strings.timeline.t5.text: With Dybvig, published research on bank runs, deposit insurance and liquidity.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Earns Yale doctorate
strings.timeline.t6.text: Completed doctoral economics training focused on financial intermediation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins Chicago
strings.timeline.t7.text: Began a long research and teaching career at its business school.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduates from Brown
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned an economics BA after initially considering biology.
